info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Fitness Memberships Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: This API enables the efficient cancellation of fitness memberships in batch. By utilizing this endpoint, authorized users can streamline the process of membership terminations, ensuring that the memberships are effectively marked as cancelled in the system. Typical consumers of this API include fitness club administrators and billing departments managing membership statuses. It supports bulk operations, improving operational efficiency when processing multiple cancellations simultaneously.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel their existing membership. Once the request is processed, the membership will be terminated, and any associated benefits will be revoked.

requestBody.description: Request body for canceling a membership. This request should contain the necessary details to identify the membership to be cancelled.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for canceling a membership operation in the application. It is expected to be a string representation of the required data.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelResponse_2.title: Membership Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the membership after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message regarding the cancellation process.

audit.description: Audit information related to the cancellation process.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelResponse_2.description: Response schema for successful membership cancellation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing audit details for the cancellation process.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
